name: Mistral Vibe Development Environment
description: Installs the Mistral Vibe IDE extension (mistralai.mistral-vibe-code) for VS Code and Cursor. Persists ~/.vibe (credentials, config) across rebuilds and Codespaces via a Docker named volume, shared per host OS user.

username.description: Username in the container that should receive the Mistral Vibe credentials symlink. 'auto' detects vscode/node/codespace/uid-1000, in that order.

installCli.description: Also install the Mistral Vibe CLI (vibe command). Requires Python 3.12+ and pip in the container.
